description.narrative: - Access to Finance: the proposed senior loan facility is expected to support the candidate MFIs to provide 112,500-127,500 loans to MSMEs and low income households, improving the underserved segment''s access to finance and contributing to the job creation in the country; - Private Sector Development: there are about 250 MFIs in Myanmar, but most of them are still not commercially operated. The proposed senior loan facility will provide the scarce and much needed commercial funding to those leading commercial MFIs or the leading MFIs transitioning to commercial operation, which will help them expand lending business and support the commercialization of Myanmar''s microfinance sector.

The project entails a senior loan facility of up to US$21 million, to provide three years local currency denominated senior loans to four to six interested microfinance institutions (MFIs) in Myanmar, to support them to obtain the scarce and much needed commercial debt financing, to reach more underserved micro, small and medium sized enterprises, and to contribute to job creation and inclusive development in the country.
